sites.rationale: ADRB2 has no signal peptide (UniProt P07550); the N-terminus (residues 1–33) is directly extracellular per the authoritative topology landmarks. insert_after_residue=0 places the tag before M1, which is the standard N-terminal prepend for a signal-peptide-free GPCR. Computed: residue_after = seq[0] = 'M'. The extracellular span is 33 residues long, placing the junction 33 residues from TM1 (34–58), well beyond the ≥3-residue minimum. PMC9681205 explicitly states 'N-terminally FLAG tagged' for the full-length, membrane-anchored receptor and validates surface display by non-permeabilized live-cell labeling and functional endocytosis. The same N-terminal position is independently corroborated by four additional ledger entries: HA tag (PMC12214593, surface FACS), SNAP-tag fused to 'N-terminal domain' (PMC9246501, surface labeling + CHX-chase), SNAP-tagged β2AR (PMC10853676, expression), and HA-B2AR-Rluc8 (PMC12962099, cAMP assay listed). All five papers describe the identical junction; PMC9681205 provides the strongest functional validation and is used as the primary supporting quote. N-terminally FLAG-tagged full-length β2AR expressed in βarr1/2 double-knockout HEK293 cells; surface display confirmed by live-cell, non-permeabilized M1 anti-FLAG labeling (Alexa Fluor 647); receptor undergoes isoproterenol-stimulated endocytosis, demonstrating preserved agonist-driven trafficking function. literature_notes: All nine ledger lines describe N-terminal tags (FLAG, HA, or SNAP) on full-length membrane-anchored ADRB2; they all support the same insert_after_residue=0 site. No ledger line reports a tag inserted in any extracellular loop (ECL1 96–107, ECL2 172–197, ECL3 296–306) or at the C-terminus. The point mutations S41A, V34A, and F49A in PMC12962099 are TM1 residues used to probe palmitoylation/lipid interactions, not tag-insertion sites. No internal extracellular loop site is proposed because the ledger provides no qualifying insertion there.
